integrity: Proof by exact equilibrium classification, interior persistence barrier, and planar Poincare-Bendixson; rational arithmetic checks are supportive and not substitutes for the infinite-time argument. Literature comparison is not proof of absolute priority.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic model, independent disease-behaviour initial condition; existence and periodic omega-limits, not period, cycle count, empirical prediction, or all four-compartment initial conditions.
title: Endogenous periodic epidemics in a quadratic behavioural-contagion SIS model
